name: app-tools-quick
description: app: add cells (console place) and pipette drops; atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const n = await moire.app.place([[100,100],[118,100],[136,100],[154,100]], moire.genome.founders[0]); return {n, alive: moire.cells.alive}
const r = []; for (const s of ['gT','t','ll','glL','trace']) r.push(moire.matter.addSpring(300 + r.length * 40, 300, 'drop:' + s, 1.5, {drop: true, rate: 40})); return r
return await moire.app.place(Array.from({length: 30}, (_, k) => [900 + 14 * (k % 6), 650 + 14 * Math.floor(k / 6)]), moire.genome.founders[3])
